mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The downward trend in FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which compresses equity risk premia and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month MA) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals a contraction in the real economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions, which depress corporate earnings expectations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The upward PAYEMS trend fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity, which boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary labor market regime (defined by UNRATE > 5.0% and negative PAYEMS growth over 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to deteriorating corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0%.
